mapper.select: select mn.* from OA_Attendance_Member mn inner join OA_Attendance_Group ag on ag.Ag_Id = mn.Ag_Id where mn.Am_Uid = #{amUid} and ag.Ag_State <> 0

select count(1) from OA_Attendance_Member mn left join OA_Attendance_Group ag on ag.Ag_Id=mn.Ag_Id left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.Pp_Id=mn.Pp_Id left join SYS_Department_P dp on pp.Pd_Id=dp.Pd_Id left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=mn.Am_Uid left join SYS_Company c1 on u.C_ID=c1.C_ID where 1=1
